hypothesis_1.note: chain starts at the variant class; the overall claim is that the variants raise Crohn disease risk ('ultimately Crohn disease development'). No route: all three steps have polarity 'unknown' and no cited text signs them (unexpressed, no_sign)

hypothesis_2.note: two genes. No route for either: the IL23R route stops at hypothesis_2.3 and hypothesis_2.4 (polarity 'unknown', no_sign), and the IL12B branch (hypothesis_2.2) ends at IL-12 production and never joins hypothesis_2.3. The run's own citation names a protective IL23R coding allele (rs11209026), which no statement can hold

hypothesis_3.note: the cited paper's mechanism runs through lower LACC1 expression (risk allele lowers LACC1 in CD4+ T cells); the run's chain skips LACC1 itself. No route: hypothesis_3.2 and hypothesis_3.4 have polarity 'unknown' and no cited text signs them

findings.detail: 9 of 11 steps have polarity 'unknown' although their wording states a direction ('impaired', 'enhanced' to 'excessive', 'leads to Crohn disease'); of these only hypothesis_3.1 and hypothesis_3.3 get a sign, from the cited LACC1 paper, and the other 7 are unexpressed (no_sign), so no claim of the run has a route.

the IL12B branch ends at 'increased IL-12 production' and hypothesis_2.3 starts at 'enhanced Th17 cell differentiation'; nothing links IL-12 to Th1/Th17 responses (only the note says the pathways 'converge'), so the IL12B claim has no route.

'excessive Th1/Th17 immune responses' bundles two responses; split, hypothesis_2.3 claims Th17 differentiation drives the Th1 response, which only the bundling says, and the Th1 half has no IL-12 input in the chain.

PMID:11385576, the only citation for hypothesis_1, is the positional-cloning association paper; it says the variants may be 'altering the recognition' of microbial components 'and/or' over-activating NF-kB, so the run picked 'impaired' sensing without a direction in the text and cites it for clearance and inflammation it never mentions.

PMID:17068223, the only citation for all four hypothesis_2 steps, is the IL23R GWAS; it never mentions Th17, Th1, IL-12 or IL12B, so it states none of the steps, including the IL12B step it is cited for.

the run's own citation PMID:17068223 says the IL23R coding variant rs11209026 (p.Arg381Gln) 'confers strong protection against Crohn's disease', yet the run claims unspecified 'Crohn-associated IL23R variants' enhance IL-23 signalling and drive disease, names no allele and lists no contradicting evidence.

PMID:40089498 tests risk allele -> lower LACC1 expression in CD4+ T cells, and LACC1 knockdown -> reduced oxygen consumption and Treg differentiation; the run's chain skips LACC1 itself, so it never commits to the direction (loss of LACC1) the paper gives.

the LACC1 chain's hypothesis_3.3 note reads 'GPR35 variants may modulate intestinal inflammation through chemokine signaling', about GPR35, which the run lists as unexplained; text leaked from another gene's draft.
PMID:28658209 is a 94-locus fine-mapping paper that mentions neither LACC1 nor any causal link from inflammation to Crohn disease; it reads as padding to meet min_sources_per_hypothesis = 2.
both chains end 'intestinal inflammation leads_to Crohn disease', but intestinal inflammation is what Crohn disease is; both texts cited for it give it only as the disease's feature.
'medium' confidence, but no cited text states any of the three steps; the one paper is an association study offering two alternative mechanisms.
'medium' confidence, but no cited text states any of the four steps, the IL12B branch is disconnected, and the cited paper's named variant is protective.
the run grounded only 'Crohn disease' (MONDO:0005011); the other 13 distinct labels have kind 'other' and no CURIE, including the gene variants.

the budget sets min_sources_per_hypothesis and min_evidence_per_hypothesis to 2, yet hypothesis_1 and hypothesis_2 each cite one paper for every step (PMID:11385576, PMID:17068223), and hypothesis_3 reaches two only with PMID:28658209, which never mentions LACC1; all three declare contradicting_evidence empty.

no identifiers for unspecified variant classes: BLN:NOD2-CrohnAssociatedVariants, BLN:IL23R-CrohnAssociatedVariants, BLN:IL12B-CrohnAssociatedVariants, BLN:LACC1-CrohnAssociatedVariants (the run names no allele).
no GO process for 'bacterial clearance'; grounded to GO:0042742 defense response to bacterium, which is broader.
no phenotype term for abnormal T cell metabolism; used HP:0032245 Abnormal metabolism (an organism-level term) refined to CL:0000084 T cell.

the guide's row 'leads_to with unknown polarity: effect only if a cited text gives the direction' sits beside the loss-of-function and undirected-change rules, which a curator can misread as giving a sign from the wording; applied as written (and as the batch's other curators did), 7 steps whose labels say 'impaired', 'enhanced'/'excessive' or 'leads to Crohn disease' become no_sign and the run has no arms, where reading the wording gives 5. The guide should say outright that labels never stand in for an unknown polarity, or say the opposite.
the undirected-change rule covers 'leads to abnormal X' (the object) but not an undirected subject ('altered T cell metabolism leads to ...'); I used the abnormal-X phenotype as the subject too.

evidence that bears on a hypothesis claim directly (rs11209026 protects against Crohn disease, against 'IL23R variants raise Crohn risk') has no place to go when no step states variant -> disease; it can only be a finding.

the kept span for LACC1 variants -> T cell metabolism is the paper's conclusion composing two tested links (allele -> lower expression; knockdown -> altered metabolism); recording it as one inVitro item overstates a variant-level test that was never run.

the guide blocks a feature-as-cause link only for bridges ('characterized by' gives no bridge); a run step 'intestinal inflammation leads_to Crohn disease' composes like any other once signed. Here both such steps (hypothesis_1.3, hypothesis_3.4) are unsigned, so they do not compose, but with a positive polarity every arm of hypothesis_1 and hypothesis_3 would end in a near restatement.

no claim of the run composes: hypothesis_1 and the IL23R and LACC1 claims each pass through at least one leads_to step with polarity 'unknown' that no cited text signs, and the IL12B branch is not connected.
PMID:40089498 reports altered metabolism and reduced regulatory T cell differentiation as parallel results of LACC1 knockdown; it does not say the metabolic change drives the T cell change.

the falsification asks for a mouse model carrying the exact Crohn-associated NOD2 variants, but its perturbation is a NOD2 knockout, which tests loss of NOD2, not the variants (whose effect the cited paper leaves open: altered recognition and/or NF-kB over-activation).
